preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The initial and target cleaning levels are between -10^9 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a non-negative integer.
If the initial cleaning level is equal to the target, no rounds are needed.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == 1 if |X - Y| is odd and |X - Y| is a multiple of a or b
postconditions.description: If the difference between the initial and target cleaning levels is odd and is a multiple of either a or b, one round is enough.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == 2 if |X - Y| is even or not a multiple of a or b
postconditions.description: If the difference between the initial and target cleaning levels is even or not a multiple of a or b, two rounds are needed.
